artifactSizeScope: Independent regular component: WASM 828917 bytes, bootstrap JS 9257 bytes, native archive 1601832 bytes. Native archive is not final executable size delta. Fonts, Rust kernel, production host, graphics and media excluded. No installer estimate or performance claim.
limitations: The 45 cases and 300 fault positions are bounded samples, not exhaustive proof for all fonts, scripts, inputs or OOM sites.
The reference CLI shares HarfBuzz algorithms; this is not independent typography or Office/WPS validation.
The raw native ABI requires valid caller pointers and alignment. A typed Rust boundary and output validation are not implemented yet.
Fresh process/WASM instance lifecycle, pooling, hard cancellation, timeout and complete memory accounting remain unimplemented.
WASM retains fd_close/fd_write/fd_seek imports; tests deny them with throwing functions and observe zero calls. Native process sandbox is not implemented.
No paragraph bidi/itemization, font selection, line breaking, outline/color glyph rendering, font embedding or presentation layout exists in this component.
The release UCD header says Unicode 18.0.0; the paragraph/layout Unicode profile is not yet integrated or verified.
ASan/UBSan cover tested native inputs; no TSan, full font fuzzing, target application validation or end-to-end benchmark is claimed.
C++ archive and Emscripten C-runtime licensing/notices and full toolchain hashes remain release work. No third-party fonts are bundled into runtime.
Variation coordinates are raw finite f32 in this private ABI. Public exact input/effective coordinate semantics remain to be implemented.
